description: Search AI tools on There's An AI For That by keyword or task name: name, short description, task, price, rating, views, saves and link. Sorting and tool type apply to task names (for example seo or video editing). Paid placements are skipped. 1 point per returned record.

keyword.description: Keyword or task. e.g. video editing

sort.description: Sort. Options: relevance = Relevance (site default), latest = Latest, top-rated = Top rated, most-saved = Most saved, popular = Popular, price = Price, sota = State of the art

tool_type.description: Tool type. Options: apis = APIs, agents = Agents, gpts = GPTs, ios = iOS, mini-tools = Mini tools, android = Android, chrome = Chrome, telegram = Telegram

name: run_theresanaiforthat_tools_search
title: There's An AI For That tools search
